summary: 3-year-old girl disappeared ~11:40 a.m. from home on Blue Spruce Rd off Ridge Rd, Nederland, in pajamas on a 33 deg F December morning; multi-agency search with command post, reverse-911 Everbridge alert, and SAR dogs staged; found ~1.5 hrs later calm and unharmed in a neighbor's home ~1 mi away after the alerted neighbor found her inside
location: Blue Spruce Rd South / Ridge Road, Nederland
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District; Nederland Police Department; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Front Range Rescue Dogs; AMR
notes: Mountain-Ear story 2090 parent-opened run 688; 'last Wednesday morning, December 17' = 2014-12-17 Wednesday-verified; story ID 2090 sits between Sept-2014 and May-2015 stories; Front Range Rescue dogs + BCS Bloodhound staged; reverse-911 credited with the find
